token_encoding: RFC4648 base64url without padding; canonical encoding required; whitespace rejected
identity: 66-byte P-521 big-endian private scalar in [1,n-1], 133-byte uncompressed SEC1 public key; reject off-curve, infinity, compressed, hybrid or noncanonical encodings

header.version: 1 byte: 1 for text, 2 for binary files

records: Header followed by peer ciphertext/tag then self ciphertext/tag. The two records have equal length; split remainder exactly in half.
role: 0 for peer record, 1 for sender record; role encoded as one byte
binding: ASCII label || role byte || U16BE(context byte length) || opaque context bytes || complete 267-byte header
context: Required opaque 1..256-byte caller data; application must bind protocol domain, sender ID, recipient ID and Telegram network. Context is authenticated but not placed in envelope.
plaintext: U32BE(original byte length) || original bytes || zero padding
text_padding: Exactly 1028 plaintext bytes, original length 1..1024; encrypted record 1044 bytes; binary envelope 2355 bytes; text token 3155 ASCII characters.
file_padding: Round (4 + original byte length) up to next 65536-byte bucket; original length 1..16777216. Decryption checks exact canonical bucket and zero padding after AEAD authentication.
self_notes: Sender and recipient public key may be equal; same format and distinct role bindings. Decrypt chooses self record when own derived public key equals expected sender key.
authentication: Caller supplies exact trusted sender public key. It must never be accepted from an unverified message. Incoming chooses peer record unless expected sender equals own public key.
fingerprint: SHA512(ASCII tele sealed fingerprint v1 || 133-byte public key), uppercase hexadecimal, groups of 4 hex digits separated by spaces.

backup.layout: ASCII magic || salt16 || nonce12 || ciphertext66 || tag16 (135 bytes total)
backup.cipher: AES256-GCM with random 12-byte nonce and 16-byte tag
backup.aad: binding with label tele sealed backup aad v1, role 0, caller context, and complete header (magic||salt||nonce)
backup.context: Required account and network binding; same account on another device must use identical context.
backup.passphrase: At least 16 Unicode scalar values, no isolated UTF16 surrogates, at most 1024 UTF8 bytes; no normalization is performed.

non_goals: No forward secrecy with static retained self-copy keys
No metadata anonymity or sender/recipient traffic hiding
No replay prevention by this stateless envelope
No endpoint or recipient compromise protection

inner_file_payload.legacy_v1: magic || U8(1) || U16BE(name UTF8 byte length) || U32BE(content byte length) || name UTF8 || content; always Document presentation
inner_file_payload.presentation_v2: magic || U8(2) || U8(presentation) || U16BE(name UTF8 byte length) || U32BE(content byte length) || name UTF8 || content
inner_file_payload.encoding: Default Document writes v1 unchanged. Image writes v2. Unknown versions/hints, trailing bytes and invalid lengths are rejected.
inner_file_payload.authentication: This entire payload is inside the file HPKE plaintext. Outer filenames, MIME types, thumbnails or document attributes must never select Image presentation.
inner_file_payload.limits: Total payload <=16777216 bytes; name 1..255 UTF8 bytes, canonical safe normalized filename.
inner_file_payload.image: Only the generic name photo.png with a valid PNG signature and CRC-checked IHDR/IDAT/IEND chunks; IHDR must be 8-bit RGBA, compression/filter 0, noninterlaced; dimensions each 1..16384 and total pixels <=16777216; successful PNG decoding required. No other chunks, trailing bytes or multiframe images. Image creation requires photo sanitization.
inner_file_payload.image_creation: After orientation and the existing 16MP input decode limit, Image presentation is smoothly resized with preserved aspect ratio to a maximum side of 2000 pixels before fresh PNG encoding. Legacy Document sanitization retains original dimensions and fails if its PNG does not fit; no implicit resize fallback. Receiver validation retains the 16MP/16384 bounds.

rich_text_v2.encoding: Canonical unpadded RFC4648 base64url of public header followed by the unchanged 2355-byte single-shot HPKE text envelope; exactly3202 ASCII characters including prefix.
rich_text_v2.public_header: U8(2) || random group32 || U8(index) || U8(count),35 bytes. Index is zero-based; count1..64; index<count. All-zero group rejected. No plaintext hash, exact length, tags or stable keys are public.
rich_text_v2.group_randomness: A fresh32-byte OpenSSL CSPRNG group identifier per rich send; entropy failure aborts without output.
rich_text_v2.context: ASCII tele sealed rich context v2 || application context17 || complete public header35. Application context is network U8(0/1) || senderU64BE || recipientU64BE, both IDs nonzero. This combined context is supplied to the existing domain-separated HPKE envelope.
rich_text_v2.fragment_plaintext: U32BE(full serialized payload length) || SHA512(full serialized payload)64 || fragment body. Metadata is inside each encrypted fragment; maximum body956 bytes.
rich_text_v2.fragment_sizes: Count must equal ceil(full payload length/956). Nonfinal fragments are956 bytes; final body is the exact remainder. No partial rich output before every fragment authenticates and the complete payload hash matches.
rich_text_v2.rich_payload: ASCII TELERTXT8 || U8(1) || U32BE(text UTF8 byte length) || text UTF8 || U16BE(dictionary count) || each(U16BE(id UTF8 byte length)||id UTF8) || U16BE(tag count) || each(U32BE(UTF16 offset)||U32BE(UTF16 length)||U16BE(dictionary index)).
rich_text_v2.canonical_rich_payload: Nonempty strict UTF8 text, no isolated UTF16 surrogates; dictionary IDs unique and sorted by UTF8 bytes; tag rows sorted by offset,length,dictionary index; rows nonoverlapping, positive length and scalar-aligned. IDs are nonempty strict UTF8 without C0/DEL controls. No duplicate/unused dictionary entries, duplicate rows, unknown version, overflow or trailing bytes. Decoder must reproduce exact canonical bytes.
rich_text_v2.tag_semantics: IDs preserve opaque native TextWithTags composite formatting and custom-emoji identifiers. Codec validates structure only; a native bridge must allow only supported safe native tag schemas before rendering.
rich_text_v2.merge_binding: SHA512(ASCII tele sealed rich merge v2 || application context17 || exact trusted sender public133 || derived own public133). Merge accepts one part per index and requires identical group/count/private size/private hash/merge binding plus the complete whole-payload SHA512. Any duplicate index, including identical replayed bytes, is rejected as ambiguous.
rich_text_v2.compatibility: Untagged text<=1024 UTF8 bytes uses existing v1 tokens unchanged. Formatted or longer text uses v2. Existing v1 reader, HPKE suites, file envelopes, backups and Apple fixtures remain unchanged.
rich_text_v2.privacy_limits: Part count and grouping are visible; Telegram can withhold or replay complete groups. There is no general replay prevention, ratchet, forward secrecy or complete plaintext RAM-erasure guarantee.
